plan.title: Create new terminal for each kanban action instead of reusing
plan.overview: Modify terminal capability to dispose the existing terminal before creating a new one, ensuring each kanban action runs in a fresh Claude context. Rename getOrCreateTerminal to createFreshTerminal to reflect the new behavior, and update all three call sites in extension.ts.

approach.rationale:
The current getOrCreateTerminal function reuses an existing terminal if one exists. This breaks context isolation when Claude is still running - new commands get sent as input to the running session. The fix is to always dispose the existing terminal before creating a new one, guaranteeing a fresh Claude instance.
Following patterns: - Factory-DI pattern at terminal.capability.ts:13-50 (closure-based state) - VSCode API encapsulation in capabilities (vscode-integration directive) - Terminal.dispose() is the correct VSCode API per spec research
No backwards compatibility needed - direct rename and update of all callers (planning directive C2).

testing.automated: None required - this is a simple rename and behavior change with no complex logic to unit test. The VSCode Terminal API is mocked poorly and testing dispose behavior provides little value.
testing.manual: - Trigger action with no existing terminal → new terminal created - Trigger action with existing running Claude → old terminal disposed, new terminal created, command runs fresh
testing.regression: Verify existing terminal commands (showTerminal, sendCommand) still work correctly
